Pinned as a regression test: tests/unit/test_migration_additive_gate.py::test_additive_gate_accepts_the_real_repo_at_the_promoted_063_revision, witnessed red (file back in deferred/) then green (file in versions/).

migrationCompatibility.notes: No NEW migration ships with this PR. 063_workflow_subject_contract was already applied to production by hand on 2026-09-20T12:06Z, per the runbook's separately-operated contract procedure -- verified after: alembic_version = 063_workflow_subject_contract, workflow_runs.subject_ref is NOT NULL, 37 of 37 rows backfilled, 0 NULL, row counts identical pre/post. This PR only moves that already-applied migration's file from database/migrations/deferred/ into database/migrations/versions/, so a fresh release checkout can resolve the database's already-stamped revision through Alembic's ScriptDirectory. expandContractOnly=true describes the file's own content (it was the CONTRACT half of the 062/063 expand/contract split, #2050) -- that content is unchanged by this PR, only its location moved. stableAndCandidateCompatible=true because the schema change it represents is already live and both stable and candidate code already expect it.

rollbackAssertion.preCutoverFailureBehavior: The additive-only gate now exits 0 (ADDITIVE-ONLY: ACCEPTED) since 063 is no longer pending once promoted. If the gate ever regressed to non-zero for an unrelated reason, deploy_lane_api returns before any candidate starts (unchanged deploy.sh ordering) and the stable release keeps serving, exactly as before this fix -- this PR does not change that ordering, it only removes the specific ResolutionError that was making the gate fail for a database correctly stamped past 062.
rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: Unchanged by this PR: deploy.sh's automatic rollback_lane on a failed public_check restores traffic to the previous stable port.

doNotInfer: Do not infer that this PR applies a NEW migration to production -- 063 was already applied by hand on 2026-09-20T12:06Z; this PR only promotes the file's location in the repo so the next fresh release checkout can resolve it.

Do not infer that the demo or landing deploy lanes are affected -- this PR's changed paths (backend/src/juli_backend/database/migrations/, tests/unit/, docs/runbooks/) only match deploy.sh's api lane_path_filters (backend/), never demo's or landing's.
Do not infer that any further database write is needed in production from this PR -- none is needed or performed; this PR is a repository-only file move plus test/doc fixes.
